svg.title: The Loom Eats Its Origin
svg.desc: Angular modulation 19.3 and radial warp 2.85 push the golden-angle loom far outside its normal controls. Signed radii repeatedly pass through the origin while thirty-four cross-strands braid against the spokes; the generous inset retains most of the enormous folded excursions. Native toolbar flow: nested path echoes → sheared radial caustic, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
